card.name: Comparison words "than" and "as" in dosing
card.fires_on: The comparison words "than" and "as" right after a drug, dose or lower-dose phrase, where a comparison to usual dosing or to placebo comes next.

modes.label: than after lower dose
modes.description: "than" following "lower dose(s)" or a drug class, introducing the usual or indicated dose.
modes.example: In patients already receiving an opioid analgesic, prescribe a lower initial dose of the benzodiazepine or other CNS depressant<< than>> indicated in the absence of an opioid,

modes.label: as in as well as / as compared to
modes.description: "as" after a drug name, starting "as well as" or "as compared to".

card.writes: It seems to favor word endings and fragments and suppress words like "likely" and "as", so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "than" or "as" when a label compares a dose or effect with a usual dose or with placebo.
